programme.desc: Todas as semanas trazemos propostas de atividades culturais para crianças e famílias de Norte a Sul do país. Sugerimos espetáculos de teatro, música, cinema, exposições, oficinas e muito mais. Uma agenda inteiramente dedicada aos mais pequenos!

programme.title: Sempre Atrasados
programme.desc: Todas as manhãs, Nuno e Malika saem de casa 30 minutos mais cedo para ir à escola e ainda assim todas as manhãs chegam atrasados! Isto porque todas as manhãs, algo incrível acontece no caminho. Mas mesmo que as suas histórias sejam sempre verdadeiras, a diretora da escola nunca acredita nelas...

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: As Aventuras de Ladybug
programme.desc: Marinette e Adrien durante o dia são dois adolescentes normais com uma vida normal, mas há uma coisa sobre eles que ainda ninguém sabe: quando algo ameaça a cidade, Marinette e Adrien transformam-se em Ladybug e Cat Noir!

programme.title: Zoe e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: UAU - Ciência Sem Limites
programme.desc: "UAU - Ciência Sem Limites" é um magazine de ciência e tecnologia produzido pela Universidade de Aveiro para dar a conhecer a investigação da Universidade de Aveiro e dos seus parceiros em áreas que tocam os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e os grandes desafios do nosso tempo.

programme.title: Esta Língua Que Nos Une - Compacto
programme.desc: A origem das palavras e curiosidade da língua portuguesa.

programme.title: Castelos do Ar
programme.desc: Apesar da sua dimensão reduzida, a Bélgica possui mais de trezentos castelos, diversificados na forma e nos materiais, como tijolo ou calcário. A água é um elemento comum a todos, com muitos a parecerem flutuar entre fossos e lagos. Estes edifícios foram, em tempos, centros de disputa pelo poder territorial e, mais tarde, símbolos de elegância senhorial. Esta riqueza histórica e arquitetónica convida a uma viagem espetacular pelo país.

programme.title: A Festa
programme.desc: Kelly fica chocada ao descobrir a verdade sobre Bazi. Ao dirigir-se para a rave, as ameaças de Kelly colocam-na em perigo.

programme.title: Fotobox
programme.desc: Programa sobre fotografia. A tecnologia, os fotógrafos e as suas fotografias têm uma presença assegurada neste programa.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Janela Indiscreta
programme.desc: O Janela Indiscreta é o seu programa de cinema! Apresenta, em primeira mão, estreias cinematográficas e entrevistas exclusivas aos protagonistas das produções nacionais e internacionais, dando a conhecer curiosidades e histórias de bastidores.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Auga Seca
programme.desc: Teresa foi longe demais ao fazer perguntas à empresa de transportes responsável por levar a maquinaria de água seca. Mauro insiste que ela precisa fazer uma pausa e ir para casa. Entretanto, a polícia interroga Sílvia.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: Teia
programme.desc: Guida Fonseca, artista e investigadora em tecelagem, dedica-se à preservação de padrões tradicionais em risco de desaparecimento, compilando um vasto arquivo através das suas viagens. Vânia Reichartz, figurinista e formadora em tapeçaria, macramé e cestaria, foi selecionada para a plataforma Emerge/Converge. Ambas as artistas partilham a missão de valorizar o têxtil, reconhecendo a sua importância na intersecção entre o artesanal e o artístico, e entre o domínio público e o doméstico.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Kiwi
programme.desc: Vamos aprender Inglês com Twiki e Twini! Cada episódio será uma aventura para descobrir novas palavras e novos sons.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Os Numberblocks são um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vão ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: A Ovelha Choné
programme.desc: Ovelha Choné? Pois esta ovelha é um pouco excêntrica, como o nome indica! Aventuras cheias de humor na quinta, sob a supervisão do Agricultor e de Bitzer, o cão pastor.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de quatro amigos que aparentam levar uma vida normal, mas viajam em segredo para a Dino Terra para estudar os dinossauros e salvá-los do perigo. É a equipa Dinoster!

programme.title: Minúsculo (5 Minutos)
programme.desc: Os nossos pequenos heróis de "Minúsculo" estão de volta com uma nova série de divertidas e surpreendentes aventuras. Desde o tranquilo campo e as montanhas envoltas em neve até às ruas de Paris e às praias ensolaradas, os nossos amigos insetos vêem-se envolvidos em situações repletas de comédia, ação, suspense e poesia. Combinando animação CGI com belíssimas paisagens filmadas ao vivo, "Minúsculo" conta as suas histórias com charme e humor, sem qualquer diálogo ou comentário.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy, o urso, e a família mais desmiolada de sempre, os Lemingues, estão de volta para novas, atribuladas e divertidas aventuras desta vez numa viagem pelo mundo!

programme.title: Sericórnio: Chuva de Estrelas
programme.desc: Num mundo mágico subaquático, Astra e as suas amigas iniciam uma aventura para resgatar uma pequena criatura com poderosa energia criativa, capturada pelo malvado Ika Inkblot, que anseia roubar toda a magia dos oceanos. Ao longo da missão, descobrem os seus poderes especiais, enfrentam desafios e valorizam a amizade, a coragem e a criatividade. Com o apoio de Kameko, uma humana transformada em Sericórnio, unem forças para salvaguardar o mundo marinho da escuridão iminente.

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de Leonel, uma mosca doméstica e filho do meio de muitos irmãos. Lloyd mora com os seus pais, a sua irmãzinha e os seus irmãos larvas dentro de um compostor a que chamam lar.

programme.title: Agenda Zigzaguear
programme.desc: Todas as semanas trazemos propostas de atividades culturais para crianças e famílias de Norte a Sul do país. Sugerimos espetáculos de teatro, música, cinema, exposições, oficinas e muito mais. Uma agenda inteiramente dedicada aos mais pequenos!

programme.title: Samuel
programme.desc: Samuel, um rapaz tímido de 10 anos começa a escrever um diário para processar os seus sentimentos, os primeiros amores, as amizades complexas e a transição da escola primária para o início da adolescência. Uma série de animação criada por Emilie Tronche.

programme.title: Refeitório
programme.desc: Um programa de conversas em torno do que é a Gastronomia com G maiúsculo, substantivada e rica, mas não apenas sobre a qualidade do prato já terminado e pronto a comer. Em cada programa, o Refeitório de Joana Barrios serve um menu exclusivo, pensado para e por uma pessoa diferente capaz de nos encher o tabuleiro de histórias.

programme.title: UEFA Liga dos Campeões Feminina - Benfica x Roma (Direto)
programme.desc: A Liga dos Campeões Feminina da UEFA 2026/27 promete uma temporada eletrizante. Dezoito das melhores equipas europeias, incluindo potências como Barcelona, Lyon e Chelsea, defrontar-se-ão numa fase de liga renovada, com cada clube a disputar seis jogos intensos. A competição arranca a 22 de setembro de 2026 e culminará na grande final em Varsóvia, em maio de 2027, garantindo emoção e rivalidade ao mais alto nível. Esta edição será, sem dúvida, uma das mais emocionantes.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Famílias como a Nossa
programme.desc: Laura faz o possível e o impossível para construir uma vida em Bucareste, embora sinta saudades da família e dos amigos durante o Natal... Especialmente de Elias.

programme.title: Aeroporto: A Escolha do Século
programme.desc: "Aeroporto - A Escolha do Século" investiga a complexa decisão do novo aeroporto de Lisboa em Alcochete-Benavente, a maior obra do século. O documentário questiona o consenso político, examinando a preterição de outras localizações e os prós e contras da opção selecionada. Analisa os impactos financeiros e ambientais, incluindo a edificação sobre um aquífero, e a lógica de investir na Portela para futura demolição, levantando dúvidas sobre soluções mais rápidas e económicas.

programme.title: Santa Bárbara
programme.desc: A beleza desta serra enquadra a vila de Santa Bárbara. É aqui que se desenrola a história de Gabriela, uma jovem a quem tiram tudo e que regressa para tudo reconquistar.

programme.desc: No programa que anima as manhãs, Cláudio Ramos e Cristina Ferreira fazem-lhe companhia. Um programa diversificado, leve e divertido, mas também com espaço para histórias densas e emotivas.Saiba mais sobre o programa no Dois às 10.

programme.title: TVI Jornal - Simultâneo TVI
programme.desc: Este é o espaço para ficar a saber as principais notícias do dia, às 13:00.

programme.title: TVI - Em cima da hora
programme.desc: Todos os casos de maior relevo, impacto e alarme que abalam a nossa segurança interna, com notícias, reportagem e análise dos melhores especialistas.

programme.title: A Sentença
programme.desc: A cada episódio, uma nova situação vai ser apresentada, proporcionando debates intensos e análises cuidadosas das evidências e testemunhos.

programme.title: Big Brother All stars - Diário
programme.desc: Há 26 anos, Portugal parou para assistir à estreia do primeiro reality show do país. Desde então, muitos foram os concorrentes que fizeram história e conquistaram um lugar único na memória do público.Agora, os protagonistas estão de volta.

programme.title: Roda da Sorte
programme.desc: O programa “Roda da Sorte” é um concurso televisivo de adivinhação de palavras ou expressões, baseado no formato internacional “Wheel of Fortune”, em que 3 concorrentes giram uma roda de prémios e tentam decifrar puzzles apresentados num painel.

programme.title: A Tvi Dá+
programme.desc: O público ao ligar o 761 100 900 inscreve-se no passatempo e habilita-se a ganhar um prémio em cartão. Para ganhar, o espectador cujo número de telefone foi sorteado, terá de atender o telefone e dizer “a TVI dá +”.E agora, há mais formas de ganhar.

programme.title: Jornal Nacional
programme.desc: O Jornal Nacional é marcado por um jornalismo atento e responsável, que se preocupa com os verdadeiros problemas do nosso tempo e das nossas vidas e os trata de forma profissional e séria. Conteúdo em língua gestual portuguesa (LGP).

programme.title: A Madrasta
programme.desc: Depois de vinte anos numa prisão em Marrocos, condenada injustamente por um crime que não cometeu, Diana Magalhães Neto regressa a Portugal decidida a recuperar os filhos e a provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: Terra Forte
programme.desc: Dada como morta no Brasil, Flor ressurge quase vinte anos depois nos Açores, trazendo uma revelação que pode mudar tudo: alguém tentou matá-la em alto-mar.

Elisa
Elisa di Rivombrosa
programme.desc:
Frumoasa Elisa Scalzi, dama de companie
a contesei Ristori, se îndrăgosteşte de fiul acesteia, Fabrizio. Din
păcate, diferenţa mare de rang şi de avere face imposibilă căsătoria
celor doi tineri. Intrigile familiei îi vor pune la încercare pe Elisa
şi Fabrizio, care vor trece prin nenumărate aventuri până să-şi
găsească fericirea. Dar, în cele din urmă, în ciuda diferenţelor
sociale şi a imixtiunilor celor răuvoitori, dragostea va iesi
triumfătoare.

programme.title: Sclava Isaura
A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. Viata Isaurei la ferma devine din ce in ce mai dificila, cand Leoncio, fiul lui Alemida, se intoarce acasa. Acesta se indragosteste nebuneste de Isaura!

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: A totalitarian future holds an annual nationally televised event in which two children from each of its regions fight to the death until only one remains. A teenage girl takes her younger sister's place in the games and must pit her wits against the deadly combat skills of her rivals. Sci-fi adventure based on Suzanne Collins' novel, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen's victory in a televised death match makes her a focus for revolution against the totalitarian nation she lives in. The rulers of the regime plot to crush dissent with a new series of games, in which past champions battle it out. Sci-fi adventure sequel based on the second book in Suzanne Collins' trilogy of novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Liam Hemsworth, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
programme.desc: Katniss Everdeen is brought to a secretive underground society following the destruction of the televised deathmatch. She becomes the figurehead of a revolution against the despotic Panem regime, while her friend Peeta remains a captive of its tyrannical president. Part one of the two-part conclusion to the sci-fi adventure series, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 2
programme.desc: The civilisation of Panem is consumed by a bloody civil war. Reluctant rebel leader Katniss Everdeen leads a band of her allies on a mission to end the conflict at one stroke by assassinating the despotic President Snow - but faces many dangers as she closes in on her target. Conclusion of the sci-fi adventure series based on Suzanne Collins' novels, starring Jennifer Lawrence, Donald Sutherland and Philip Seymour Hoffman in his final role.

However, Hawks, preoccupied with a pretty Sioux woman, Onahti (Elsa Martinelli), doesn't realize that there's conflict until it's too late.

programme.title: The Big Country
programme.desc: Retiring to the American West to marry his fiancée, Patricia Terrill (Carroll Baker), Captain James McKay (Gregory Peck) enters a land-and-water feud between his future father-in-law, Major Terrill (Charles Bickford), and the rough and lawless Hannassey family, led by Rufus (Burl Ives). McKay prefers peace between himself and the Hannasseys, who repeatedly attempt to provoke violence. But his steadfast demeanor only angers his fiancé and Major Terrill, who won't settle for truces.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: In 1836, the Mexican army, led by General Santa Anna, is invading Texas. Hoping to create a diversion for Santa Anna's forces, General Sam Houston (Richard Boone) orders Colonel William B. Travis (Laurence Harvey), joined by Colonels Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and Davy Crockett (John Wayne), to lead a small, heroic band of American and Texican fighters in a resistance battle at the Alamo mission. The carnage at the Alamo further spurs the Republic of Texas toward freedom.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: Headstrong Thomas Dunson (John Wayne) starts a thriving Texas cattle ranch with the help of his faithful trail hand, Groot (Walter Brennan), and his protégé, Matt Garth (Montgomery Clift), an orphan Dunson took under his wing when Matt was a boy. In need of money following the Civil War, Dunson and Matt lead a cattle drive to Missouri, where they will get a better price than locally, but the crotchety older man and his willful young partner begin to butt heads on the exhausting journey.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Great gambler Sam Whiskey (Burt Reynolds) has got his hands on a heist job that's pretty outrageous, even by Wild West standards. A drop-dead-gorgeous woman (Angie Dickinson) wants to quietly give back the gold her husband had stolen, now that he's dead. She approaches Sam to retrieve the gold from the bottom of a river and smuggle it back into the mint. The widow's beauty, and the nice sum she promises him, leave Sam powerless to resist the preposterous proposal.

His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Bigamist
programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. When private investigator Jordan (Edmund Gwenn) uncovers the fact that Graham has another wife, Phyllis (Ida Lupino), and a small child in Los Angeles, he confesses everything. In flashback, Graham tells of the strains in his marriage with Eve and how he found himself falling for the kind-hearted waitress Phyllis while on a business trip.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Sue Thomas F.B.Eye
programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. When she is given the tedious task of analyzing fingerprints, Sue is disappointed but doesn't remain there for long. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.title: Greatest American Hero
programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.desc: Bill is planning to leave the railroad worker camp and move on, but a former crewman shows up to make trouble; Bill learns the man is working as field agent for the company that the workers hoped to get a new contract from.

programme.desc: Bill saves a government agent from an ambush; the agent is carrying a list of landowners who are refusing to pay their taxes, and Bill learns the daughter of one of those landowners arranged the ambush.

programme.title: The Texan
programme.desc: Bill finds a town engulfed in a feud between two ranchers; he also learns that his former commanding officer is now a doctor who's turned to drinking, and a young man blames him for crippling his arm.

programme.desc: A lynch mob wants to hang a young man convicted of killing a family of homesteaders; Bill rides in with a stay of execution from the governor just as the mob is about to break into the jail; the desperate prisoner escapes.

programme.desc: Bill takes the job of escorting a convicted killer to his hanging, knowing that the man's sons and gang members are planning to free him.

programme.desc: Bill goes after the three men who had forced him to accompany them on a bank robbery then framed him for it after.

programme.desc: Bill escorts a prisoner to Pueblo for trial; he is also to deliver money to the prisoner's mother for his daughter, whom she has custody of; the two men encounter a dust storm, which forces them to take refuge in a ghost town.

programme.desc: Bill hopes to prove that his friend Steve Murrow is innocent of killing the man who married the girl he was hoping to marry, but he only has 24 hours to do it before Steve is hung; the town sheriff has threatened to kill Bill if he frees Steve.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York.

programme.title: The King of Comedy
programme.desc: Rupert Pupkin (Robert De Niro) is a failure in life but a celebrity in his own mind, hosting an imaginary talk show in his mother's basement. When he meets actual talk show host Jerry Langford (Jerry Lewis), he's convinced it will provide his big break, but Langford isn't interested in the would-be comedian. Undaunted, Pupkin effectively stalks Langford -- and when that doesn't work, he kidnaps him, offering his release in exchange for a guest spot on Langford's show.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel.

programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: After Dark, My Sweet
programme.desc: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts.

programme.title: Any Last Words?
programme.desc: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: The Hawk of Powder River
programme.desc: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Prairie Badmen
programme.desc: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, while the son wants to keep it for themselves. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: Susanna Pass

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.desc: Part 1/3. As life starts evolving in the oceans, our bizarre earliest ancestors battle against 3m long sea scorpions and giant carnivorous fish. programme.title: Walking with Beasts

programme.title: Walking with Beasts

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: Going back 25 million years to the time of the indricothere, which was the largest mammal ever to live on dry land, being seven metres high and weighing 15 tons! The only threat to an adult would have been the hyaenodon which was the size of a rhino and had jaws that could crush a rock.

programme.title: Walking with Beasts
programme.desc: The beginnings of mankind can be traced back 3.2 million years to Ethiopia and the advent of Australopithecus, a type of ape which, like humans, was bipedal. These early members of the human family faced many dangers, including the sabre-toothed cat, malaria, and the 14-tonne delnotherium.

programme.title: Science of Walking With Beasts

programme.desc: Part 2/3. As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.desc: The life of the first reptilian carnivores on Earth, told through computer animation.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A look at the world as it was 149 million years ago - in the late Jurassic Period. The old continents have broken up and much of the land is under water. Huge shallow seas have supported a revolution in marine life.

programme.title: Walking with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: A mind-expanding trip back through time to look at how the skies of 127 million years ago were dominated by huge flying reptiles, some as large as aeroplanes. programme.desc: Discover why correctly understanding biblical prophecy is essential to faith in Jesus Christ. This lesson examines Christ’s encounter with the disciples on the road to Emmaus, where He used Moses and the Prophets to reveal how all Scripture pointed to Him. Their disappointment came from a one-sided interpretation of Messianic prophecy, but Jesus opened their understanding and transformed confusion into conviction. Explore sound principles for interpreting prophetic writings, avoiding false expectations, and allowing Scripture to explain Scripture as God reveals Christ, strengthens faith, and brings spiritual clarity and lasting hope.

programme.desc: Join Greg and Jill Morikone on Miracles in Motion for an inspiring episode titled Never Too Late, featuring Hershell, a 100% disabled veteran who found his way to the Lord later in life. Raised in Oklahoma and moving schools frequently, he began his spiritual journey at age 70, finding solace in Pastor Murray’s sermons at Shepherd’s Chapel. But it was 3ABN that truly captured his heart, offering Bible-based teachings that aligned with Scripture, not tradition. Hear how 3ABN became his church family, inspiring him to be baptized and study the Bible with his son and daughter-in-law. Despite struggles with being in church, 3ABN provided the truth and support he needed. Don't miss his testimony of how 3ABN helped transform his life and brought him closer to Christ.

programme.desc: In a time when religious terminology often creates confusion, Scripture calls us back to clarity through diligent study and prayer. This program invites viewers to set aside human labels and explores how the Bible itself reveals the nature of God. programme.desc: In Fundamentals of Parenting, Dr. Mark Sandoval presents a radically biblical framework for raising children—one rooted not in control, behavior management, or coercion, but in God’s design for love, freedom, and self-government. Using Scripture, spiritual law, and practical illustrations, he explains why children are born unable to govern themselves, how sinful nature operates like a prison, and why external control often produces hypocrisy rather than transformation. This episode clarifies the difference between God’s government and civil government, the proper role of authority and discipline in the home, and how parents serve as stewards rather than owners of their children. Viewers are guided through how discipline, obedience, education, worship, and correction can cooperate with God’s work of freeing the heart—so children learn to take God as their source and live in harmony with His will.

Pharaoh’s refusal to let Israel go wasn’t just defiance—it was economic greed, a grip on power built on the backs of slaves. programme.desc: Have you ever visited someone and just wished you didn't have to say goodbye when you left? Maybe you were visiting your grandparents or a good friend who lives far away from you. In our lesson today we will be talking about heaven and how we will never have to say goodbye when we get there.

programme.title: Grandma's House
programme.desc: Cave-in-rock is a cave we are going to visit today that has a rich history of folklore. What's that you say ? Well there are stories that have been told for many, many years about this cave and a few other near by places that we will learn more about today. We will try to discover if there is any truth to these stories and what that might mean to you and me. Join us for this adventure today!

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: El sábado como un don amoroso de Dios
programme.desc: En esta transmisión especial de dos horas, el pastor John Dinzey, gerente general de 3ABN, y el pastor Eduardo Mack profundizan en el estudio bíblico del sábado, destacándolo no solo como un día de reposo, sino como un regalo divino destinado a restaurar la vida espiritual, emocional y relacional del creyente. A lo largo del programa, ambos pastores presentan el fundamento bí blico del sábado desde la creación hasta el ministerio de Jesús, subrayando su carácter santificado por Dios y su propósito como un espacio sagrado para reconectar con Él. También exploran su relevancia para la vida actual, mostrando cómo la observancia del sá bado fortalece la fe, la identidad espiritual y la relación con el Creador. El objetivo central del programa es invitar al espectador a comprender el sábado como un don amoroso de Dios, diseñado para renovar el corazón y enriquecer la experiencia cristiana hoy. Para una variedad de programas de estudios bíblicos, baje la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscríbase al canal 3ABN Latino YouTube. Envie sus preguntas a Latino@3abn.tv Programa EVH250007.

programme.title: Melodías de Victoria
programme.sub-title: MelodíAs De Victoria Con Ysis EspañA
programme.desc: En este episodio de Melodías de Victoria, el presentador Pedro Carriles recibe a la talentosa Ysis España, una artista cuyas canciones han tocado los corazones de miles de personas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 25 años de trayectoria, Ysis ha sido testigo del poder transformador de la música y el llamado divino en su vida. A lo largo de esta entrevista, descubriremos más sobre su ministerio musical, las lecciones aprendidas en su caminar con Dios, y las inspiradoras anécdotas de cómo Él ha guiado cada paso de su carrera. ¡ No te pierdas esta conversación única y llena de inspiración! Este y otros programas enriquecedores son parte de la programación que ofrece 3ABN Latino. programme.desc: En el Lugar Santo del santuario había una mesa de pan. Jesús dijo: “ Yo soy el Pan de Vida”. Después de nacer de nuevo y convertirnos en cristianos, debemos crecer en Cristo alimentándonos de la Palabra, el Pan de Vida. programme.title: Flash Gordon
programme.desc: The vintage sci-fi comic strip character gets a 21st-century makeover in this freewheeling adaptation that sends All-American track star Steven "Flash" Gordon on a series of wild adventures that begins when he falls through an interdimensional rift in space and lands on the planet Mongo, accompanied by his old flame from high school, Dale Arden. Flash is looking for clues to the fate of his father, the eminent scientist Dr. Lawrence Gordon, previously believed to have died in a laboratory fire several years earlier. His quest, however, leads him into the clutches of Ming, the evil ruler of Mongo, and his devious daughter, Aura. Flash escapes back to Earth, vowing to foil the ruthless Ming's threat to humanity. Fortunately, in addition to Dale, Flash can count on help from Baylin, a beautiful but tough intergalactic bounty hunter, and Hans Zarkov, the eccentric former associate of Flash's father.

programme.title: Cracking The Genesis Code
programme.sub-title: The Serpent, The Woman and the Seed
programme.desc: On the surface the book of Genesis appears to be a mere collection of ancient stories. But don't be fooled! Beneath the external simplicity lies a secret code which, when broken, reveals in no uncertain terms what will happen in the future. This series reveals the intimate connection between the first book of the Bible, Genesis, and the last book, Revelation. Don't miss this life changing experience!

programme.title: Mission Revival - Outpost Centers International
programme.desc: Hosted by Steve Dickman and Michelle Song, this series brings to light the desperate need for outreach in all areas of the world. While Seventh-day Adventism has made it's mark, there are still areas of the world that have yet to be touched. This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry. "And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.." (Matthew 24:14).

programme.title: Living Well
programme.desc: "So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." (1 Corinthians 10:31) How can we use food to glorify God? When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: Anchor 2026: The Minor Prophets
programme.sub-title: The Origin and Demise of the Jewish Theocracy - Part 2

programme.title: The Incredible Journey Season 7
programme.sub-title: Rembrant - The Man Who Turned The World Upside Down
programme.desc: Throughout history, the Dutch have fought for important causes and become pioneers in social and economic changes that Europe and other countries have imitated. Known as a tolerant society, this has let important Dutch people leave their mark without judgment. Today, we will follow in the footsteps of one of the Netherlands’ most loved and famous citizens, Rembrandt Harmenszoon van Rijn (simply known as Rembrandt), whose talents and masterpieces have touched the hearts and lives of people worldwide for centuries. The life and works of this gifted Dutchman will highlight the typical Dutch character, creativity, innovation, and inherent capabilities for which they are famous. More importantly, his masterpieces will highlight how we can all find true happiness and inner peace. So, stay with us because Rembrandt’s discovery, use and understanding of Light, could change your life forever.

programme.title: It Is Written Canada
programme.desc: Mike and René Lemon are the hosts for It Is Written Canada, a nationwide television ministry that spotlights the life-transforming power of trusting God’s Word.

programme.title: Summit 2020: The Hour of His Judgement
programme.sub-title: Pastor C.A. Murray - He Sits Before He Stands
programme.desc: This Secrets Unsealed Summit discusses various matters related to the investigative pre-Advent judgment that began in 1844 and will end at the close of probation. Theological concepts with a practical tips for daily living will help us prepare to stand before the judgment bar of God.

programme.title: The Heart of Babylon
programme.desc: We are living in the "Time of the End" just before probation closes. Satan is doing his best to draft members of Gods Church into his Babylonian kingdom. Can you be called a Seventh-day Adventist, while really belonging to the Kingdom of Babylon?

programme.title: God's Prophetic Chain
programme.sub-title: But He Spoke Like A Dragon
programme.desc: History is not composed of a series of disconnected and haphazard events. Rather, it is carefully choreographed chain of events that were predicted millenia ago by God. In this series Pastor Bohr traces God's great prophec chain, link by link, from Ancient Babylon to the end of time. Special attention is dedicated to the end-time conflict and the glorious deliverance of God's faithful remnant. You will be amazed at the predictive preciosion of Bible prophecy and your faith in the Master of history will grow exponentially.

programme.title: Misunderstood Texts on the State of the Dead
programme.sub-title: Absent from the Body & Present with the Lord
programme.desc: Pr. Stephen Bohr. Study the difficult passages that the Protestant world uses to defend their views on life after death. Learn how to defend what the Bible really teaches on this subject.

programme.title: Last Generation Theology
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Iniquity Vs The Mystery Of Godliness
programme.desc: What is Last Generation Theology? Very likely you've heard this phrase in the church during the past few years. Is it an anti-gospel, legalistic heresy, as some have alleged? Or is it the Bible-based rationale for the existence, message, and mission of the Seventh-day Adventist movement? The purpose of this symposium is to take these questions to the Bible and the writings of the Spirit of Prophecy to discover God's answers.

programme.title: Anchor 2022: What Jesus Said
programme.sub-title: What Jesus Said About How to Pray
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them.

programme.title: Born Again
programme.desc: What does it really mean to be "born again"? Is there a line between convinced and converted Adventits? In this seven-part series Dojcin Zivadinovic discusses what true conversion looks like according to the Bible and how we can all experience this re-birth.

programme.title: Timeless Healing Insights from the Gospel of Mark
Authentic - with Shawn Boonstra
programme.desc: In Authentic, the flagship television and radio program of the Voice of Prophecy, Pastor Shawn Boonstra pursues the deepest questions of human existence.

programme.title: Apostasy: Theological Analysis of the Davidian Movement
programme.desc: Untangling the web of error can be exhaustingly complex. In this series, you will learn to discern the counterfeit. The Davidian Movement, often called the "Shepherd's Rod", has hooked many unsuspecting Bible students who are seeking "Present Truth". By the end of this series, you will recognize and be able to refute the major Davidian doctrines such as Ezekiel 9, the stone of Daniel 2, and the pre-millennial kingdom, as well as their commonly used Bible and Spirit of Prophecy references. You will have a clear understanding of truth by rediscovering the beauty of Adventism; guarding yourself against deception or helping someone already involved with a dissident group. Ephesians 6:11-19 tells us to put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand firm no matter what evil the devil sends your way. False prophets shall arise (Matt 24:11) and false theories, clothed with garments of light, will be presented to God's people… seducing influences exerted; minds hypnotized (Maranatha, Feb 20, "Beware of Satan's Agents", p.59:1). There are grievous wolves in our mists, men speaking perverse things, drawing away disciples after them (Acts 20:29-30). BEWARE! Take heed that no man deceive you (Matt 24:4). "God will arouse His people, if other means fail, heresies will come in among them...We should present sound arguments that will not only silence our opponents, but will bear the closest and most searching scrutiny.. ." (5T, 707:3 - 709). Search the Scriptures and the Spirit of Prophecy by the grace of the Holy Spirit. The speaker has done just this. Praise God! Through His miracle, Ismael was brought out of the Shepherd's Rod deception. Finally, through this series, it is time to set the record straight.

programme.title: Summit 2025: Put on the Whole Armor of God
programme.sub-title: The Final Faith of Jesus - Stephen Bohr

programme.title: The Bible's Two Mysteries
programme.desc: In this study, Pastor Bohr explores the relationship between God the Father and Jesus Christ, Christ's full divinity and eternal existence, the distinction between the Father and the Son, how this relationsip is revealed through Creation...and much more!

programme.title: The Battle for Liberty Conscience
programme.sub-title: The Protestant Roots of Religious Freedom
programme.desc: "The Constitution of the United States guarantees liberty of conscience. Nothing is dearer or more fundamental. Pope Pius IX, in his Encyclical Letter of August 15, 1854, said: `The absurd and erroneous doctrines or ravings in defense of liberty of conscience are a most pestilential error--a pest, of all others, most to be dreaded in a state.' The same pope, in his Encyclical Letter of December 8, 1864, anathematized `those who assert the liberty of conscience and of religious worship,' also 'all such as maintain that the church may not employ force.'" {GC 564.5}.

programme.title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
programme.sub-title: Lesson 48: The Salt of the Earth
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

programme.title: The Book of Acts
programme.desc: In the days of the early church—before modern technology or powerful institutions—the Gospel was proclaimed with boldness and urgency across the world. What lessons can today’s remnant church draw from their example? In this compelling series, Kameron Devasher uncovers essential truths from the Apostolic church that will both inspire and challenge remnant believers to share the Three Angels’ Messages with conviction and determination, using every means available.

programme.desc: This summit will discuss the different purposes in God appointing us, an imperfect people, to spread the gospel around the world.

programme.title: Remodeling Your Life - Talking Donkey Int.

programme.title: Cortinas De Humo
programme.desc: En 1844 culmina la profecía más extensa de la Biblia. En el drama có smico supra-humano, las tinieblas lucharon por oscurecer los acontecimientos celestiales que se iniciaron 2300 años antes en el 457 a. C. En rápida secuencia una serie de sucesos golpearon las noticias. Aparece el Espiritismo, nace el Evolucionismo, se incia el marxismo-comunismo, se descubre el Código Sinaítico, se genera un edicto de tolerancia a favor de los judíos, surge la Alta Crítica de la Biblia, nacen los discipulos de Cristo, y las Asociación cristiana de jóvenes (YMCA), las comunicaciones ya se producen por telégrafo (cumpliendo el anuncio de Daniel profeta), y el movimiento cristiano se abre paso anunciando la pronta venida de Cristo.

programme.title: Ancla 22: El calendario religioso hebreo
programme.sub-title: La mano que mueve la historia
programme.desc: Antes de que Jesús viniera a esta tierra, se sentó con Su Padre y planeó los siete pasos sucesivos que daría en el plan de salvación. Sin embargo, no sólo planificaron los pasos, sino que también prepararon un calendario detallado de cuándo se llevarían a cabo estos pasos. El santuario hebreo revela los eventos de la historia de la salvación y las fiestas revelan el calendario de esos eventos. Este estudio se centra en las siete fiestas y su relación con el santuario. Se incluye un estudio de la temporada del nacimiento del Mesías, los tres días y tres noches, y si los cristianos todavía está n obligados a observar las fiestas. Este estudio fortalecerá su fe en el Dios que conoce el fin desde el principio.

programme.title: Apostasía: Análisis teológico del movimiento Davidiano – Dr. Ismael Rodríguez
programme.sub-title: El rey en el reino de gloria según V.T. Houteff
programme.desc: esenredar una red de errores puede ser agotador y complejo. En esta serie aprenderás a discernir lo falso de lo verdadero. El movimiento Davidiano, alias, "La Vara del Pastor", ha atrapado a muchos estudiantes incautos de la Biblia que buscan la "Verdad Presente". Al concluir esta serie usted reconocerá y estará apto para refutar la mayor parte de las doctrinas davidianas, tales como Ezequiel 9, la piedra de Daniel 2, y el reino pre-milenario, así como las referencias bíblicas y del Espíritu de Profecía más usados. Usted tendrá un mayor conocimiento de la verdad al redescubrir la belleza del adventismo, prevenir el engaño y ayudar a alguien que ya está envuelto con un grupo disidente.

programme.title: La gran cadena profética
programme.sub-title: La espada, el cautiverio y la bestia de la tierra
programme.desc: La historia no se compone de una serie de eventos desconectados o casuales. Por el contrario, es una cadena cuidadosamente coreografiada de acontecimientos que fueron predichos milenios atrás por Dios. En esta serie el Pastor Bohr traza la gran cadena profé tica de Dios, eslabón por eslabón, desde la antigua Babilonia hasta el fin del tiempo. Especial atención se dedica al conflicto del tiempo final y la liberación gloriosa del pueblo remanente fiel de Dios. Le sorprenderá la precisión predictiva de la profecía bí blica, y su fe en el Maestro de la historia crecerá grandemente.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.","large":"Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.","large":"After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

A Los Angeles high-school teacher (Samuel L. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.desc: An abandoned 1967 C10 that has been sitting for years has been sold to a client who wants a few new touches, but closer inspection reveals more work is needed.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave convinces the client to make the 1967 C10 truck into a convertible; Kevin takes on a new personal project with a Cadillac Escalade.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The engineering on the convertible C10 works in theory, but making it work in practice is the next step; a team brings in a replica 1967 Cobra with a bad engine.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest -- the Hebmüller; there are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking steps to turn it into a hot rod; Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a challenge for the shop.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged; this time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave's clients have owned a car since they got married 25 years ago and want it restored so they can enjoy it for another 25; while the shop isn't really into straight restorations, adding some custom pieces and paint makes them say yes to the pro.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.sub-title: It's a Barn Door Deluxe, Of Course
programme.desc: Dave is thrilled with the latest build, while KevDogg is barely lukewarm; Dave has done double-cab VWs, Bugs and Karmann Ghias, but now he is taking on something completely different, and even more rare.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Matching the two-tone paint job is the challenge of the day as the '53 Barn Door Deluxe build carries on; custom trim, a new, more powerful engine, 22 windows and a custom interior all come together to make this surprise worth the wait.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and the guys at Kindig-It proved they could execute Dave's vision of his production Corvette, but now that a few have sold, they have to get them completely finished.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin, who have been an absolute treat for automotive enthusiasts for years, come back to the SEMA show with something special on their minds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show as far east as they have ever gone and head to Lake George, New York, for the Adirondack Nationals; the town shuts down for the car show, attracting some of the best on the east coast.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1970s Pantera is an iconic sports car, but once Dave gets his hands on it, the style will never be the same; the client has given Dave free rein to change the car as he sees fit, but has one request: he is 6'4" and can't comfortably get in it.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the whole team in agreement over the body mods, the crew must make the designs into reality; their list of tasks include bulging out the fenders, creating a spider-shaped exhaust, executing the stretch and getting the car to body.

programme.desc: We test six manifolds with our old-school carb and our new-school 6.0 LS.

programme.desc: The guys see if exhaust cutouts do more than rattle passersby's eardrums.

programme.desc: The crew super-tunes every HP out of the 410 Windsor from the Disgustang.

programme.desc: The guys test how different carb features affect horsepower and tunability.

programme.desc: The guys challenge their previous findings testing single-pattern cams.

programme.desc: The guys see if too much oil pressure robs precious horsepower.

programme.desc: The guys see how wet and dry nitrous systems stack up on an EFI manifold.

programme.desc: Multipoint EFI gets its turn against the venerable Dominator.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Realpolitik
programme.desc: Il reddito di cittadinanza torna a dividere la politica e l'opinione pubblica. Tra chi ne chiede a gran voce il ripristino e chi ne contesta l'efficacia e i costi, le testimonianze e le diverse posizioni di chi vorrebbe rivedere la misura.

programme.title: Leone: La forza di un papa
programme.desc: Entriamo dentro la figura del Pontefice, con ospiti e testimonianze che ne raccontano il percorso sotto una luce diversa.

programme.title: Come eravamo
programme.desc: Frammenti di programmi televisivi del passato riproposti oggi, per la gioia di chi c'era e di chi non c'era.

programme.title: Caduta libera
