programme.title: StartUp
programme.desc: This gritty drama follows unlikely tech entrepreneurs behind a brilliant idea, and a powerful FBI agent ("Sherlock" star Martin Freeman) who can make or break those he comes in contact with -- not always for the right reasons. Set in Miami, Izzy Morales creates a revolutionary, unregulated digital currency called GenCoin. A young banker named Andy decides to partner with Izzy, infusing the project with cash that Andy's father is desperate to conceal. The trio ends up on the radar of FBI Financial Crimes Agent Phil Rask, who is on Andy's trail.

programme.title: Powering the Future
programme.desc: Dr. M. Sanjayan, lead scientist at The Nature Conservancy, shines a spotlight on America's quest for clean energy. The four-part series addresses the challenge from every angle and cuts through all the rhetoric by establishing a target: identifying a clean, limitless, secure energy supply and a way for it to be delivered. Sanjayan discusses new technologies that could end the dependence on fossil fuels; explains how the natural world can create energy; filters out politics and special interests to reveal statistics on energy waste; and tells of unlikely characters and companies that are leading the way in an energy sea change.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Viele Tiere beeindrucken durch Ausdauer: Kaiserpinguine senken die Herzfrequenz zum Sauerstoffsparen, Monarchfalter nutzen Fettreserven für die Migration, Gabelböcke haben ein robustes Herz-Lungen-System und Albatrosse können Meerwasser trinken.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Diese Meister der Tarnung machen sich vor aller Augen fast unsichtbar. Chamäleons verändern durch spezielle Hautzellen ihr Aussehen, Stabheuschrecken ahmen Zweige nach und Polarfüchse bekommen durch hormonelle Umstellungen im Winter ein weißes Fell.

programme.title: Wildes Mittelmeer
programme.desc: Wölfe streifen durch die Berge des Mittelmeerraums, wo sie große Beute wie Hirsche und Steinböcke jagen. Als Rudel sind sie erfolgreich - ihre Beute teilen sie mit Aasfressern. Ein perfektes Beispiel für das harte Überleben in der Wildnis.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation führt in den atlantischen Regenwald Brasiliens und stellt seine Natur vor. Diese beheimatet bemerkenswerte Tiere wie Jaguare, Kaimane, Blaubrustpipras, Wasserschweine, Ameisenbären, Riesenotter und Delfine.

programme.title: Planet der Papageien
programme.desc: Farbenprächtig, intelligent, sozial - Papageien haben ihren eigenen Charme. Weil ihre natürlichen Lebensräume schrumpfen, siedeln sich weltweit immer mehr der bunten Vögel in Städten an. Zugleich werden besonders gefährdete Arten extra gezüchtet.

programme.title: Wilde Insel Borneo
programme.desc: In dieser Dokumentation geht es um die außergewöhnliche Artenvielfalt auf Borneo. Dabei zählen unter anderem Orang-Utans bis hin zu Malaienbären zu den beheimateten Tierarten, die das tropische Inselreich für sich beanspruchen.

programme.title: Nil - Fluss der Flüsse
programme.desc: Der Nil ist mit 6.650 km der längste Fluss der Welt. Er durchquert diverse Landschaften von den Tropen bis zum Mittelmeer, verbindet Kulturen und dient als lebenswichtige Ader für die Wüstenregionen und Metropolen im Sudan und Ägypten.

programme.title: Nil - Fluss der Flüsse
programme.desc: Mit 6.650 km ist der Nil der längste Fluss der Welt. Er entspringt in Ruanda, speist sich aus Äthiopien und fließt als Lebensader durch die Wüste und Kairo ins Mittelmeer. Sein Weg führt von kleinen Quellbächen über den Viktoriasee zum Delta.

programme.title: Nil - Fluss der Flüsse
programme.desc: Der Tanasee ist das größte Reservoir des Blauen Nil. Auf seinem Weg durch die Wüste im Sudan und Ägypten passiert der Fluss bedeutende Stätten der alten ägyptischen Hochkultur, wie die Pyramiden von Meroe, Luxor und das Tal der Könige.

programme.title: Könige des Himalaya
programme.desc: Mit seinen majestätischen Hörnern und seinem Bart ist der Himalaja-Steinbock ein großes und kräftiges Tier, das in Höhen von etwa 3.500 bis 5.000 Metern lebt. Das Leben dieser Tiere in einer rauen und wunderschönen Landschaft wird gezeigt.

programme.title: Beeindruckende Spürnasen

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: In den 1920ern gehen erste Touristen auf Reisen. Nach dem Krieg kommt der Tourismus richtig in Schwung: Im Westen ermöglicht das Wirtschaftswunder den Individualtourismus. Ostdeutschland setzt auf organisierten Staatstourismus.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1891 beginnt die erste organisierte Kreuzfahrt der Geschichte. Dabei ist auch Albert Ballin, der die Hapag zur weltweit größten Reederei ausbaut. Auch in der Bundesrepublik erfreuen sich Kreuzfahrten großer Beliebtheit.

programme.title: Die Lust am Reisen - Wie die Deutschen zu Reiseweltmeistern wurden
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1919 startet das erste maßgeschneiderte Passagierflugzeug der Welt. Nur sieben Jahre später wird in Berlin die "Deutsche Luft Hansa AG" gegründet, die die Nationalsozialisten skrupellos für ihre Zwecke ausnutzen.

programme.title: Titans of Defense

programme.title: Tödliche Autorennen
programme.desc: In deutschen Großstädten kommt es immer wieder zu illegalen Autorennen. Junge Männer fahren nachts durch die Straßen und präsentieren ihre aufgemotzten Autos. Regelmäßig werden auch Unbeteiligte mit hineingezogen, im schlimmsten Fall mit Todesfolge.

programme.title: Löschen, retten, helfen
programme.desc: Die Feuerwehr Hamburg kann mehr als nur Brände löschen. Oft geht es um Leben und Tod. Mal haben es die Einsatzkräfte mit Weltkriegsbomben zu tun, mal mit Menschen, die einfach nur einsam sind. Die Reportage zeigt sie bei ihrer aufreibenden Arbeit.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.desc: Diese Reportage berichtet von Frauen, die zu Mörderinnen wurden. Die Journalistin Alexandra Pfeil spricht mit zwei Expertinnen über Hintergrundinformationen der Psyche der Täterinnen. Gemeinsam erforschen sie, warum Frauen zu Killern werden.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.sub-title: Eiskalte Verbrechen - Wenn Liebe tödlich endet
programme.desc: In diesem Teil der Reportage werden Geschichten von Frauen erforscht, die von ihrer großen Liebe ermordet wurden. Alexandra Pfeil spricht mit zwei Expertinnen darüber, was die Täter dazu bewegt, ihre Partnerinnen zu töten.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Angst auf dem Heimweg - Wie sicher fühlen sich Frauen?
programme.desc: Im März 2021 schlug der Mord einer Frau in Großbritannien Wellen. Sarah Everard wurde auf ihrem Nachhauseweg von einem Polizisten vergewaltigt und ermordet. Die Sendung geht der Frage nach, wie Frauen zukünftig besser geschützt werden können.

programme.title: Spiegel TV - Reportage
programme.sub-title: Zwischen Kult und Krawall - unser Kiez Hamburg!
programme.desc: In dem Hamburger Kiez steht der Wirt Daniel Schmidt seit 20 Jahren hinter der Theke. Auf der Reeperbahn gibt es unzählige Bars und Clubs sowie auch die Wunderbar, die bereits seit 32 Jahren ein fester Teil der schwulen Community ist.

programme.title: Blut und Spiele für die Polizei: Fußball-EM in Deutschland

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Thunder Town
programme.desc: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Military-industrial thugs kill a Marine (Daniel Hugh Kelly) to keep him quiet, but his ex-Marine wife (Amy Madigan) fights back.

programme.title: After Dark, My Sweet
programme.desc: After escaping from a mental hospital, drifting ex-boxer Kid Collie (Jason Patric) meets an alcoholic widow, Fay (Rachel Ward), who entices him into performing maintenance work at her estate. When crooked Uncle Bud (Bruce Dern) joins the two, Fay's darker side begins to appear. Bud and Fay concoct a scheme to kidnap the son of a local wealthy family and have Collie carry out the dirty work, to which the troubled ex-boxer agrees, but he soon has second thoughts.

programme.title: The Blood of Heroes
programme.desc: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite.

programme.title: Lulu on the Bridge
programme.desc: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

programme.desc: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States.

programme.title: The Lawless Frontier
programme.desc: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. programme.title: Chappaquiddick
programme.desc: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

programme.title: All Souls Day: Dia de los Muertos
programme.desc: When young lovers Joss (Travis Wester) and Alicia (Marisa Ramirez) arrive in a small Mexican town, they inadvertently stumble upon an attempted human sacrifice. Eventually they find their way to the local sheriff, Blanco (David Keith), and begin to piece together the supernatural puzzle, which involves the dead rising from their graves. As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Blackheart
programme.desc: A con artist (Richard Grieco) leaves his partner for dead and pursues a woman (Fiona Loewi) with a $10 million inheritance.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: Rival gangs hire a British thug (Mick Rossi), who was imprisoned for eight years, to complete a hit in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Bar 20 Justice
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy gets the drop on some miners robbing ore from the heroine's mine.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

programme.desc: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Yankee Fakir
programme.desc: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. programme.title: Call of the Jungle
programme.desc: Trouble comes to a tropical island paradise when sacred pearls are stolen from a tribal temple. Local amateur sleuth Tana (Ann Corio) decides to investigate the matter to find out who's responsible, but following leads only earns her a place on the authorities' list of suspects. Meanwhile, a police officer, Jim (James Bush), is injured while working on the case, and Tana, nursing him back to health, attempts to get him to team up with her to track down the real crooks.

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

rating.system: Instituto Nacional de Cine y Artes Audiovisuales

programme.title: Solomon and Sheba
programme.desc: Near death, King David has a vision that his poet son, Solomon (Yul Brynner), should succeed him, rather than hot-headed Adonijah (George Sanders). Furious, Adonijah departs the court, swearing he will become king. Other rulers are concerned that Solomon's benevolent rule and interest in monotheism will threaten their tyrannical, polytheistic kingdoms. The Queen of Sheba (Gina Lollobrigida) makes an agreement with the Egyptian pharaoh (David Farrar) to corrupt Solomon for their mutual benefit.

programme.title: The Satan Bug
programme.desc: Special Agent Lee Barrett (George Maharis) joins forces with Ann Williams (Anne Francis), a general's daughter, to recover a biological weapon stolen from a secret government lab. Learning that the pathogen could destroy all life on Earth, they focus their attention on a mysterious millionaire who may have orchestrated the theft. After annihilating a small town in Florida, the villain turns his attention to Los Angeles -- and the duo must race to stop the city's destruction.

programme.title: Call of the Wild
programme.desc: Based on Jack London's classic about two gold-seekers who forge their way to the Klondike with their faithful dog Buck.

programme.title: True Heart
programme.desc: Twin brother and sister Sam and Bonnie, who argue frequently, become stranded after surviving a horrific plane crash in the Canadian wilderness. While struggling through the forest, they meet a wily Native North American named Khonanesta, who agrees to help them reunite with their family. As the trio traverses the treacherous wood, they strive to elude poachers who wish to hunt Khonanesta's adored Kodiak bear companion.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: Legend of the Lost
programme.desc: Brit Paul Bonnard (Rossano Brazzi) enlists gruff American Joe January (John Wayne) to help him find a hidden treasure that is worth a fortune. Before long, they are joined by prostitute Dita (Sophia Loren), who is moved by Bonnard's earnestness, and the three embark on a journey through the wild in hopes of finding an ancient lost city. They finally stumble upon the riches, but, after Bonnard feuds with Dita, he angrily takes the jewels and supplies, and leaves his partners to die in the desert.

programme.title: Ski Patrol
programme.desc: Pops (Ray Walston) is the longtime owner of an easygoing ski lodge, but its future is put in jeopardy by cutthroat businessman Sam Maris (Martin Mull). programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Masquerade
programme.desc: The British government is in negotiations with the Middle Eastern oil-rich nation of Ramaut to allow in British drilling agencies, but Ramaut withdraws from the talks, leaving Britain desperate. Drexel brings in American David Frazer (Cliff Robertson) to assist, but Frazer finds someone else has plans for Jamil.

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

Elizabeth bears John's son and eventually marries her kindly boss. Unknown to her, John has survived but is horribly disfigured and remains in Europe. Years later, on the eve of World War II, Elizabeth refuses to agree to her son's request to enlist and is stunned when an eerily familiar stranger named Kessler arrives from abroad and becomes involved.

programme.title: Separate Tables

Meanwhile, Mrs. Railton-Bell (Gladys Cooper) and her daughter Sibyl (Deborah Kerr) discover the hidden truth about war veteran Major Pollack (David Niven).

When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Youth is in full swing at Oceancrest College, and no place swings harder than the Silver Palms, the choice hot spot for student Sandy (Pamela Tiffin) and her pals. Sandy's uncle, Woody (Woody Woodbury), who performs a comedy act at the club, has his livelihood threatened when wealthy conservative Edgar Cronin (Robert Middleton) attempts to shutter the wild hangout for good. This makes things especially sticky for Cronin's grandson, Ding (James Darren), who's trying to get a date with Sandy.

programme.title: Just for Kicks
programme.desc: A stranger tries to help twin brothers (Cole Sprouse, Dylan Sprouse) who play for a winless soccer team.

programme.title: Ski Party
programme.desc: In this musical, college classmates Todd Armstrong (Frankie Avalon) and Craig Gamble (Dwayne Hickman) head out on a group ski vacation, and agree that if they're going to get girlfriends, they need to understand how women think. So when they arrive at the ski lodge, Todd and Craig dress up as young women and pal around with female classmates. Though this provides a bit of insight, the plan goes awry when a male classmate falls for the female version of Craig and pursues him all over the resort.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Beach Party
programme.desc: Dolores (Annette Funicello) and Frankie (Frankie Avalon), attractive young surfers in Southern California, are just out for a good time. Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: Sergeant Deadhead
programme.desc: After setting off a rocket during a parade, Sergeant Deadhead (Frankie Avalon) is sent to a guardhouse by his commanding officer, General Fogg (Fred Clark). While attempting to escape, Deadhead accidentally boards a rocket and launches himself into space with a chimpanzee. Deadhead and the chimpanzee are eventually recovered by the air force, but upon his return to Earth, it becomes clear that Deadhead has undergone an unbelievable personality change.

programme.title: Heart of a Child
programme.desc: An Austrian boy's (Richard Williams) cruel father (Donald Pleasence) plans to sell his Saint Bernard to a butcher.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

rating.system: Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: Extremities
programme.desc: Marjorie (Farrah Fawcett) manages to fight off a rapist and flee to safety. Because her attacker got away and Marjorie has no proof of the crime, police officers tell her there is little they can do. Because Marjorie's attacker also stole her purse, she fears that he will use its contents to track her down. When Joe (James Russo) does show up at Marjorie's house to finish what he started, he discovers that Marjorie is not the fragile victim he imagined.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: A Cold Wind in August
programme.desc: A 28-year-old stripper (Lola Albright) on vacation seduces the 17-year-old son (Scott Marlowe) of her New York building's superintendent.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Despite being far from home, American jazz musicians Ram Bowen (Paul Newman) and Eddie Cook (Sidney Poitier) are content living and working in Paris. Ram knows it's the best place for him to develop his musical reputation, and Eddie is far away from the racism that once greeted him on a regular basis. But after meeting and falling in love with American tourists Lillian (Joanne Woodward) and Connie (Diahann Carroll), the pair must decide whether their artistic integrity is worth abandoning.

programme.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
programme.desc: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: The Children of Times Square
programme.desc: The mother (Joanna Cassidy) of a runaway (Brandon Douglas) tries to save him from a cocaine dealer's (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) youth gang in New York.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

Crazy from the heat, Davenport turns on his men, forcing McCoy to go against his commanding officer in order to save the lives of others.

programme.title: The Return of Sabata

programme.title: Ride Out for Revenge

Tate (Rory Calhoun), who is secretly in love with Pretty Willow, is sent to scout a new location for the Cheyenne. Tensions quickly arise between the cavalry and the vengeful Chief Little Wolf (Vince Edwards).

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail

That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Cast a Long Shadow

Initially, Matt plans on selling the ranch, but then decides to keep it, hoping to impress his ex-lover, Janet (Terry Moore). The ranch, however, turns out to be in foreclosure, forcing Matt and Chip to come up with a plan to pay off their debt to the bank.

By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Trooper Hook
programme.desc: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him.

programme.title: Escort West
programme.desc: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.desc: A single mother (Candace Cameron Bure) adopts a dog for her daughter (Katie Hawkins), then meets a ballplayer (Victor Webster) who claims to be the animal's owner.

programme.title: It's a Mann's World
programme.desc: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. programme.title: Espejo público
programme.desc: Reportajes sobre temas variados que atañen a diferentes clases sociales, noticias de interés público que están haciendo parte de los titulares en los medios de comunicación, las mejores entrevistas políticas, son una parte de este magazín informativo que ha estado vigente por más de una década. El programa además incluye investigaciones especiales de toda índole y analiza las problemáticas de forma profunda y desde un punto de vista objetivo, se incluye un segmento con las quejas y denuncias del público y se comentan las opiniones de la audiencia televidente que sigue al programa, la cual se conecta directamente por medio de la página web de forma dinámica.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: लव लव लव
programme.sub-title: Amit, the son of a taxi driver, and Reema, a rich businessman's daughter, fall in love. However, Reema's father wants to marry her to Vicky, whose father is the biggest gangster in Mumbai. How will their love triumph?
programme.desc: टैक्सी ड्राइवर के बेटे अमित और अमीर व्यवसायी की बेटी रीमा को प्यार हो जाता है। हालाँकि, रीमा के पिता मुंबई के गैंगस्टर विक्की से उसकी करना चाहते हैं।.

credits.actor: Aamir Khan,Juhi Chawla,Gulshan Grover,Dalip Tahil,Om Shivpuri,Sarla Yeolekar

programme.title: आइ एम 24
programme.sub-title: A 42-year-old writer falls in love with a 22-year-old beauty queen. However, things get complicated when his roommate encourages him to make up stories to impress her
programme.desc: 42 वर्षीय लेखक, शुभेंदु को 22 वर्षीय शीला से प्यार हो जाता है। हालांकि, शीला को लुभाने के लिए वह अपनी उम्र छिपाने और कम बताने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Rajat Kapoor (Shubendu Roy),Ranvir Shorey (Gagandeep Singh),Neha Dhupia (Sheela),Manjari Phadnis (Kanak),Delnaaz Irani (Delnaaz Paul),Saurabh Shukla (Bollywood Director Sidhwani),Lillete Dubey (Don's Wife),Arjun Rampal (Arjun Rampal)

programme.title: दो प्रेमी
programme.sub-title: Lovers Payal and Chetan elope as their families disapprove of their relationship. They start a new life working for Geeta, unaware of her true nature and affiliations
programme.desc: प्रेमी, पायल और चेतन भाग जाते हैं क्योंकि उनके माता-पिता उनके रिश्ते को स्वीकार नहीं करते हैं। वे गीता के लिए काम करते हुए नया जीवन शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन वे गीता के असली इरादे से अंजान हैं।.

credits.actor: Rishi Kapoor (Chetan Prakash),Moushumi Chatterjee (Payal / Parvati Singh Dogra),Om Prakash (Retd. Col. Bhagwant Singh),I.S. Johar (Daulatram),Deven Verma (Morari Bhonsle),Roopesh Kumar (Suresh),Bhagwandada (Bhagwan),K.N. Singh (Geeta's uncle)

programme.title: डांस डांस
programme.sub-title: Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned
programme.desc: दो अनाथ बच्चे, राधा और रामू पैसे कमाने के लिए सड़कों पर गीत गाकर नृत्य करते हैं और बड़े होकर लोकप्रिय कलाकार बनते हैं। लेकिन, राधा की मृत्यु के बाद रामू शराबी बनने से प्रदर्शन करने में असमर्थ रहता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty (Ramu 'Romeo'),Smita Patil (Radha),Mandakini (Janita),Shakti Kapoor (Resham),Amrish Puri (Raja Bahadur A.M. Singh),Om Shivpuri (David Brown)

programme.title: नया कदम
programme.sub-title: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher
programme.desc: मधुकर और जग्गू, एक गाँव के लोगों पर शासन और जुल्म करने के लिए उन्हें शिक्षा से वंचित रखते हैं। हालाँकि, रामू, एक स्कूल शिक्षक की मदद से गुप्त रूप से शिक्षा प्राप्त करता है।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna,Sridevi,Padmini Kolhapure,Jaya Prada,Kader Khan,Om Shivpuri

programme.title: एस.पी. चौहान
programme.sub-title: Satpal Chauhan, a social worker from Haryana, works for women empowerment and also strives to create an alcohol-free society. However, while pursuing his goals, he faces several hardships
programme.desc: हरियाणा के सामाजिक कार्यकर्ता सतपाल चौहान महिला सशक्तिकरण के लिए काम करते हैं और शराब मुक्त समाज बनाने के लिए भी प्रयासरत हैं। हालाँकि, लक्ष्य का पीछा करते हुए उन्हें कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Jimmy Sheirgill,Yuvika Chaudhry,Yashpal Sharma,Deepak Mor,Amit Jairath,Baljinder Kaur,Shrawya Shreya Rajput,Vijay Kumar Dogra,Joginder Kundu

programme.title: बंबई का बाबू
programme.sub-title: Babu, who kills a man, is blackmailed by Bhagat into assuming the identity of a wealthy heir, Kundan, for his money. However, things get complicated when Babu falls in love with Kundan's sister
programme.desc: बाबू अपने एक पूर्व-मित्र को मारता है और भगत उसे एक अमीर आदमी शाहजीका उत्तराधिकारी कुंदन होने का नाटक करने एवं उसकी संपत्ति लूटने के लिए ब्लैकमेल करता है।हालाँकि,बाबू को शाहजी की बेटी से प्यार होता है।.

credits.actor: Dev Anand,Suchitra Sen,Nasir Hussain,Dhumal,Manohar Deepak,Achala Sachdev,Rashid Khan,Jagdish Raj

programme.title: नील कमल
programme.sub-title: Sita's sleepwalking turns out to be a cause of concern to her husband and family. When they investigate, they realize that her current behaviour is linked to her previous life
programme.desc: सीता के नींद में चलने की बीमारी उसके पति और परिवार के लिए चिंता का कारण बनती है। जब वे पड़ताल करते हैं, तो उन्हें पता चलता है कि उसका यह व्यवहार उसके पिछले जन्म से जुड़ा हुआ है।.

credits.actor: Raaj Kumar (Chitrasen),Waheeda Rehman (Rajkumari Neel Kamal/Sita),Manoj Kumar (Ram),Shashikala (Chanchal),Lalita Pawar (Thakurain),Balraj Sahni (Mr. Raichand)

programme.title: मेरा दामाद
programme.sub-title: Jai's father asks him to meet Sunita before getting married to her. However, complications arise when Jai falls in love with Kimi, while on his way to Sunita's village
programme.desc: जय के पिता उससे शादी करने से पहले सुनीता से मिलने के लिए कहते हैं। हालाँकि, मुश्किलें तब पैदा होती हैं जब सुनीता के गाँव जाते समय जय को किरी से प्यार हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Farooq Shaikh (Jai Khanna),Zarina Wahab (Kimi/Sunita),Ashok Kumar (Barrister Ajit Khanna),Utpal Dutt (Sitanath Chaudhary),Rakesh Bedi (Ravi),Prema Narayan (Shalu),Brahmachari,Master Bhagwan,Jankidas (Shalu's Bapu)

programme.title: Officer Arjun Singh IPS
programme.desc: Arjun Pratap Singh, an IPS officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges and embarks on a mission to restore peace in society.

credits.actor: Priyanshu Chatterjee (Arjun Singh),Raai Laxmi,Arshad Siddiqui,Vijay Raaz,Govind Namdeo,S.M. Zaheer

programme.title: चांद का टुकड़ा
programme.sub-title: NRI Shyam comes to India to fulfil the final wish of his late mother who wanted him to marry an Indian girl. Unbeknownst to him, the girl he falls in love with is a pawn in the hands of his enemies
programme.desc: श्याम अपनी दिवंगत मां की अंतिम इच्छा को पूरा करने के लिए भारत आता है जो चाहती थी कि वो भारतीय लड़की से शादी करें। अनजाने में वो एक लड़की से प्यार करता है जो उसके दुश्मनों के हाथों का मोहरा बनी है।.

credits.actor: Shatrughan Sinha,Sridevi,Anupam Kher,Salman Khan,Raza Murad,Mehmood,Rakesh Hans,Zeba Khan,Rama Vij

programme.title: 盜劍 / Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍，誘殺師弟談鶴鳴；談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭，伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師，練成一身武藝，並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意，深夜到親王府盜劍，然而寡不敵眾，失手被擒；嬌龍率眾營救，與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。.

programme.title: 勾魂降頭 / Black Magic 2
programme.desc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症，無法以醫學理論解釋，遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查，才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術，以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人，博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說，其妻子更不惜以身相試，更被施以「死降」，如果無法破解，二十四小時後便會身亡….

programme.title: 獵人 / Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事，周丟棄劉明華，又去追獵呂綺美，劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚，呂遭殺死，警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人，一個一個的被殺死，嫌兇漸指向他，好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。.

programme.title: 鬼畫符 / The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: 周鵬被神捕諸葛森追殺，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所殺，要求鵬二人帶其鬼魂上路，到開封找公孫先生消滅杜鬼魂。鵬以大少奶的鬼符在賭場贏取路費，更與戲子吳順超一同上路...

programme.title: 七煞 / To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」，在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅，並派臥底從內瓦解組織，隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫，幕後壇主可會找出臥底？.

programme.title: 雲泥 / When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。.

programme.title: 報仇 / Vengeance
programme.desc: 玉樓發現武館師傅封與妻子有著曖昧情愫後，最後更被傅封所殺。玉樓的弟弟小樓得悉兄長被殺後，誓要為兄報仇。.

programme.title: 仙女下凡 / The Human Goddess
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活，某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟，險遭不法之徒欺騙，幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼，七妹屢施法術相助，卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持，情愫漸生，共同守護孤兒院的未來。.

programme.title: 插翅虎 / The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: 若結合武林兩大魔頭，插翅虎及活閻王，的武功，他們必定獨霸武林，江湖又將有一輪腥風血雨。活閻王為促成這個邪惡聯盟，決將胞妹嫁給插翅虎。究竟最後二人之毒計會否得逞？誰可挽救一場武林浩劫？.

programme.title: 阿牛入城記 / The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 這部喜劇描述鄉下人阿牛來港後，因生性戇直而經常被壞人利用。阿牛嘗盡低下層社會的人情冷暖，最後更被判入獄！究竟天生樂觀的他，能否吉人天相？.

programme.title: 五毒 / The Five Venoms
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽，各擅勝場，不同型格。電影風格奇特，一開始五毒門清理門戶，派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門，卻受師父追殺，有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运，張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇，沒有他慣常的大義浩然，卻有天地不容的毀滅性。.

programme.title: 怒海情仇 / Call of the Sea
programme.desc: 故事描述，青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好；土豪獨子耀祖，垂涎小玉美色，時藉故親近；一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂，金虎抱不平，幾動武，惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係….

programme.title: 來如風 / The Swift Knight
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾，駕崩在即，卻無子可繼帝位；皇侄世子傑本可繼位，惜不成器，難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一，現時藏匿于東陽縣，遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺，幸得俠士來如風相助...

programme.title: 十三太保 / The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: 故事講述于唐朝年間，沙陀國主有十三義子，皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英，因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間，最後更演變成兄弟相殘。.

programme.title: 十三太保 / The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: 故事講述于唐朝年間，沙陀國主有十三義子，皆獲太保銜。姜大衛飾演的十三太保為戰場精英，因而引起兄弟間的嫉妒及挑撥離間，最後更演變成兄弟相殘。.

programme.title: 十字鎖喉手 / Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: 李成鷹的父親被多年好友凌豪設計所殺。李成鷹從父親身上學會“十字鎖喉手”的秘技，誓要為死去的父親報仇。於是，他潛入凌家作護衛，期間也巧遇失散多年的兄長，兩兄弟聯手大戰殺父仇人。.

programme.title: 蝴蝶盃 / The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: 明朝時代，書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義，誤殺總督之子，被迫逃亡。走投無路時，他逃至江畔，幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生，玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物，締結終身之約。.

programme.title: 鷹王 / King Eagle
programme.desc: 某天，名震江湖的鷹王遇見重傷的天一堂六舵主，他臨終前告訴鷹王天一堂堂主已被大舵主洪擎天所害，鷹王雖不願多管閑事，但還是遭到洪摯天及其手下顏冰兒的追殺。其後，鷹王出手拯救被監車壓住的女孩，遭到暗算，幸得天一堂七舵主顏玉蓮相救，兩人結為朋友。鷹王告知顏玉蓮六舵主的遺言，並指出其胞妹冰兒不是善類….

programme.title: 玉女嬉春 / The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展，兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀，江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角，老父回來見三位女兒成就，開心不已。.

programme.title: 艷陽天 / Blue Skies
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛，常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人，得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出，心卻惦念燕南，一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執，怎料汽車失事...

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳 / The Brave Archer
programme.desc: 郭靖回到中原時，遇上黃蓉，二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料，同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿，對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰，郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克，奪得美人歸。.

programme.title: 天使出更 / Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: 話說醫務署發覺聖慕倫醫院的醫療水準及設備大有問題，原來該院院長體弱多病，院務交陳醫生主理；但陳個性主觀，行事不依規章，連手下一班見習醫生亦各具「特性」，時鬧笑話，弄至院務混亂。院長決定聘用資深護士長進行改革...

programme.title: 文素臣 / The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察，他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺，聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。.

programme.title: 鬼馬神偷 / The Big Sting
programme.desc: 魯俊谷、張權、於洋三人乃沙煲兄弟，三人合力獲得寶物「雙面神」，不料卻給胡起尾注，將三人毒殺，獨吞「雙面神」。劉永、梁家仁及梁韻蕊是他們的後人，在不打不相識之下重逢，為了完成亡父的遺志，三人齊心向胡偷回寶物。韻蕊早已混入胡家中，色誘胡之子，作為內應查出「雙面神」之收藏地點。永與家仁則扮鬼扮馬，偷天換日，最後偷得雙面神！.

programme.title: 惡虎村 / Village of Tigers
programme.desc: 九姑娘之兄巴傑勾結惡虎村惡霸胡蛟，圖劫鏢銀，被「鐵沙掌」駱宏勛打傷。胡蛟恐事發後被巴家追究，下毒將巴傑毒斃，嫁禍駱宏勛，巴家上下誓欲殺死駱報仇…….

programme.title: 藍與黑續集 / The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集，唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯，在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞，但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍，叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。.

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍 / The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: 楊家將被敵軍突襲，幾近全軍覆沒，僅存兩名兒子生還。楊家五子遂逃入少林寺，向少林僧人學習「狼牙棒法」，後來更創出「五郎八卦棍」。最終，楊五郎與眾寺僧聯手，為楊家將報仇。.

programme.title: 梅山收七怪 / Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: 小哪吒偷吃了仙界桃樹的一個新結仙桃，但又不慎將另外七個仙桃弄落凡間，導致七隻不同動物變成妖怪。哪吒要在十天內收復妖怪，否則父親會被天帝懲罰。到底哪吒能否完成任務?

programme.title: 劍女幽魂 / Mission Impossible
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師，途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇，藉寶劍靈氣還魂，竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師，更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上，升天而去。.

programme.title: 劍女幽魂 / Mission Impossible
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師，途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇，藉寶劍靈氣還魂，竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師，更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上，升天而去。.

programme.title: 冰天俠女 / Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害，雙腳更被凍至殘廢；長大後練就非凡武功，矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識，天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來，卻對她的遭遇非常同情，主動為她治好腳疾…….

programme.title: 林沖夜奔 / Pursuit
programme.desc: 此片述說了關於林沖的故事。宋朝禁軍教頭林沖遭受貪官陷害，被放逐滄州，更陷入險境。幸得花和尚相助，林沖成功脫險，更展開復仇大計。.

programme.title: 金石情 / Forever And Ever
programme.desc: 劉貞蓮不幸身患麻瘋，其父劉員外招贅窮書生李孝文為婿，意圖賣瘋傳毒。貞蓮將真相和盤托出，孝文感於貞蓮真情，決意回鄉稟明母親，迎接貞蓮返家。孝文走後，貞蓮萬念俱灰，竟狂飲毒酒，以圖自盡...

programme.title: 魔劍俠情 / Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: 狄龍扮演的小李悄然回到愛侶故園之旁隱居，遙對窗中倩影，而不相見，直至發生危機，小李才露面相告，並且挺身赴難。有不少高手為爭“武林排名”而找小李決鬥，小李又要對付惡勢力龐大的幫主谷峰，於是小李找尋舊友阿飛相助，但阿飛被陰險美女林仙兒所迷，簡直變成廢人，小李於是揭破這女人的假面目，並且設法使阿飛振作起來。.

programme.title: 女兒國 / The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: 本片講述唐僧、孫悟空、豬八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取經，行至西梁女兒國，國內全是女人，而傳宗接代生兒育女全靠「招胎泉」，飲過這泉水便可成孕，但也只能生女。.

programme.title: 十二金牌 / The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: 奸相秦檜偽造十二道金牌，密謀強召抗金前線的岳飛退兵。華山俠士苗龍為救國運，率江湖義士沿途設卡攔截金牌。不料護送金牌的爪牙首領竟是其恩師金彥堂，令苗龍陷入忠義兩難。最終師徒在客棧反目血戰，苗龍雖拚死奪下金牌，卻仍難挽回歷史的千古遺憾。.

programme.title: 馬哥波羅 / Marco Polo
programme.desc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅，聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告，到中國各地考察三年，回京後，適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺，幸得蒙古高手護駕，一死一逃；馬憑死者遺言，判斷餘黨必在揚州；馬被任命為總督，率兵將反元者一網打盡；惟馬抵揚後，有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心，遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士...

programme.title: 青春鼓王 / King Drummer
programme.desc: 船員孫志强巧合成爲「火花大樂隊」的鼓手，他因急于成名，答應幫助音樂雜志出版人李源明接近樂隊經理黃麗真，以換取源明的力捧。終于，志强得償所願，一炮而紅，源明却逼他實踐諾言，與麗真斷絕來往。志强受到極大打擊，唯有忍痛離開樂隊與麗真...

programme.title: 影子神鞭 / The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: 三十萬鏢銀被持神鞭作武器的劫鏢者劫去。因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之稱的武林大師方承天的招牌武器，所以他的嫌疑最大，也因此引來連番追捕。自此以後，方消聲匿跡。十五年後，年輕女子楊寒雲突然出現，更拿著與當年一樣的神鞭。究竟這位女子是誰？「影子神鞭」的下落又如何？.

programme.title: 蕭十一郎 / Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: 蕭十一郎被人冒名作惡，送"割鹿刀"托連城璧殺蕭。寶刀途中被軒轅無敵奪去。軒欲強搶美女沈璧君，蕭英雄救美。蕭行蹤敗露，被連伏擊重傷，幸為沈所救。蕭決意將寶刀取回...

programme.title: 鐵羅漢 / The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: 追風刀劉鵬為采花大盜小天尊所殺，遺言徒弟盧漢去京師尋護龍刀復仇。途上，盧助康氏姊妹玉笙與玉簫退敵；抵京後又路見不平，救韓五嫂一命，因而結識韓的女兒牡丹...

programme.title: 邪完再邪 / Hex after Hex
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素，欲與其結合，央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親，撮合一段人鬼姻緣，馬素年青憨直，不願與鬼為伍，堅決拒絕，實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，決定伺機行動。.

programme.title: 笑傲江湖 / The Proud Youth
programme.desc: 華山派大弟子令狐沖要找出一個繼承「笑傲江湖」琴譜的人。當令狐沖發現任盈盈為合適人選時，卻發現她竟是魔教教主任我行之女，同時他亦一步步捲入正邪兩道的權鬥陰謀和道義兩難的困境。.

programme.title: 不了情 / Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中，夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南，兩人漸生情愫，卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時，青青卻得知一個噩耗，最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。.

programme.title: 不了情 / Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: 在這部浪漫愛情經典中，夜總會歌女李青青邂逅英俊青年湯鵬南，兩人漸生情愫，卻在感情路上經歷無數誤會、分離和折磨。當他們終於重燃愛火時，青青卻得知一個噩耗，最終無奈迎來悲慘的結局。.

programme.title: 龍虎鬥 / The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: 日本空手道高手及被逐出師門的刁二返鄉踢館，一眾師徒不敵二人，慘遭屠殺。弟子雷明刻苦鍛鍊武功，決心憑一己之力報仇雪恨。一場龍虎對決就此展開….

programme.title: 邪 / Hex
programme.desc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋，家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病，而振宇又鬱鬱不得志，故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現，聯同秀英反抗，竟錯手將振宇殺死！秀英自始活在驚恐之中，最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死！原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英，就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際，秀英鬼魂出現...

programme.title: 少林傳人 / Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位，率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮；皇帝見大勢已去，命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下，大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養，法號道行，習得少林絕技；二太子則易名五子泰，由丞相撫養。多年後，五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」，與道行相遇，卻不知對方正是親兄弟…….

programme.title: 如來神掌 / Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: 年輕龍劍飛武功低劣，但在一次偶然的機會下，被火魂邪神古漢魂收為義子，並獲傳授八式如來神掌。龍劍飛從此脫胎換骨，成為武林高手。為報師仇，古漢魂命龍劍飛下山替他找仇人報仇，江湖風暴遂再牽起….

programme.title: 白蛇傳 / Madam White Snake
programme.desc: 妖精白素貞跟妹妹青青在凡間巧遇前世救命恩人書生許仙，後更以身相許給許仙。後和尚法海揭穿其身份並把這對苦命鴛鴦拆散...

programme.title: 血滴子 / The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: 馬騰是雍正的密令組織「血滴子特務團」的其中一位殺手。當馬騰質疑其特務行動是否有違道義時，卻旋即變成被同伴追捕的逃犯。.

programme.title: 山歌戀 / The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: 牧羊女古秀秀喜唱山歌，父親嗜賭如命；青年劉大龍與秀對唱山歌，情愫互生。曾老虎以追債要脅古老頭許婚；劉欲酬錢替秀父還債。怎知帆船歸來而劉卻失蹤！秀無奈答允出嫁...

programme.title: 皇家大賊 / Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: 幹探周福祥的好友阿金因誤殺途人而辭職，淪為職業殺手。金所執行的多宗兇殺案中，恰巧由周負責，好友二人面臨生死決鬥...

programme.title: 噴火美人魚 / Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: 三對年青男女出海渡假，忽然聽到新聞報導：一個穿紅色比堅尼泳衣的女郎一連殺了十三人，並正駕駛著快艇逃亡。正在此時，一個美的女郎破浪而來，身穿紅色比堅尼。女郎要求跟他們同上島避風。當晚，女郎的挑逗令眾男女之間產生前所未有的衝突... 電影未到最後一分鐘，不知結局。.

programme.title: 奪魂鈴 / The Bells of Death
programme.desc: 故事描述，少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫，父母幼弟被殺，姊衛芸被左劫走，頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀，放火燒毀家園，決心遠走天涯，找尋仇人報復；虎流浪各地，遇隱名大俠士，投拜為師，數年即習藝有成，遂往找仇人；虎抵雞兒鎮，遇弱女香香遭逼為娼，逐出手相助，擊退歹徒...

programme.title: 城市之光 / Family Light Affair
programme.desc: 導演張堅庭在本片體現香港八十年代的大城小景；陳友與妻子惠英紅從大陸來港投靠父親，卻發現他並非如信中所言生活富足。東方之珠的美夢換來悲喜交集。.

programme.title: 教頭 / The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害，成殺人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒，卻惹孟不滿；原來周、孟兩大族為死敵，孟覺聘王當教頭，實乃養虎為患，遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲，幸王逃過大難，只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為，且對王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 椰林春戀 / Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: 富少平建人拒絕繼承父業，與女友蘇詠蘭合辦旅行社。在接待來自香港的旅行團時，一名情竇初開的女學生愛上建人，引發一連串愛情誤會。詠蘭醋意大發憤然離去，女學生因驚聞建人婚訊而恍惚駕車撞山重傷。經過一番波折，眾人終於解開誤會，建人與詠蘭也在南洋椰林下迎來幸福結局。.

programme.title: The World Today

programme.title: Dialogue
programme.desc: Dialogue is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN. programme.title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Parasit
programme.desc: Cika (Yuriska Patricia) terjebak dalam permainan licik Jono (Cahya Nagara), supir yang membawa masuk Aini (Bunga Elizabeth), adiknya dan Bu Siti (Koming), ibunya untuk menguasai rumah serta toko warisan orang tua Cika. Di sisi lain, Arham (Bara Valentino), penjahit yang diam-diam menyayangi Cika, tak berdaya saat Cika dipaksa menikah dengan Jono demi menutup aib palsu.

programme.title: Pisang Crispy Jatuh Di Hati
programme.desc: Della (Yuki Kato) yang sedang jualan pisang crispy mendadak heran ketika melihat Zacky (Naufal Samudra) tampak kebingungan ketika mobilnya yang membawa pisang nangka mogok. Saat Della mau membenarkan mobilnya, Zacky malah menertawakannya. Zacky malah nantangin Della kalau berhasil akan ia memberi satu karung pisang nangka. Ternyata Della mampu dan membuat Zacky memberikan satu karung pisang nangka. Della senang karena bisa ia jual namun kakinya langsung lemas manakala gerobak jualannya hilang dicuri. Della menyalahkan Zacky karena telah membuat semua ini terjadi.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Parasit

programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Resep Cintaku Di Ghosting Tanpa Syarat
programme.desc: Meski datang dari latar belakang keluarga yang berbeda, Yogi dan Karin dipertemukan melalui insiden tak terduga.

programme.title: Penghulu Ganteng Idolaque
programme.desc: Danu (Fauzan Nasrul) akan jadi penghulu untuk pernikahan Susan (Angelica Simperler) dan Aldo (Joshua Otay). Tetapi Susan malah masuk ke mobil Danu dan juga minta dibawa kabur. Ternyata Aldo ketahuan selingkuh oleh Susan. Gimana ya petualangan Susan dan penghulunya?

programme.title: Pulang Malu Gak Pulang Makin Rindu
programme.desc: Aldo yang merantau ke Jakarta sudah 3 bulan lamanya setelah lulus kuliah, belum juga mendapat pekerjaan. Aldo melamar sebagai teknik mesin disebuah perusahaan travel, namun sayangnya Aldo malah ditawarkan menjadi supir.

programme.title: Cinta Kan Membawamu Ke Titik Bahagia
programme.desc: Reno yang hanya penjual pecel bertemu dengan Tiara yang berpura pura menjadi orang disabilitas untuk menelusuri Reno. Tiara harus bersandiwara karena disuruh oleh ayah Reno untuk mengawasi Reno dan menyelidiki kehidupan Reno. Namun ditengah tugasnya Tiara jatuh hati kepada Reno begitupun Rno yang ternyata menaruh hati ke Tiara.

programme.title: Keluarga Suami Adalah Parasit
programme.desc: Cika (Yuriska Patricia) terjebak dalam permainan licik Jono (Cahya Nagara), supir yang membawa masuk Aini (Bunga Elizabeth), adiknya dan Bu Siti (Koming), ibunya untuk menguasai rumah serta toko warisan orang tua Cika. programme.title: Pisang Crispy Jatuh Di Hati
programme.desc: Della (Yuki Kato) yang sedang jualan pisang crispy mendadak heran ketika melihat Zacky (Naufal Samudra) tampak kebingungan ketika mobilnya yang membawa pisang nangka mogok. Saat Della mau membenarkan mobilnya, Zacky malah menertawakannya. Zacky malah nantangin Della kalau berhasil akan ia memberi satu karung pisang nangka. Ternyata Della mampu dan membuat Zacky memberikan satu karung pisang nangka. Della senang karena bisa ia jual namun kakinya langsung lemas manakala gerobak jualannya hilang dicuri. Della menyalahkan Zacky karena telah membuat semua ini terjadi.
